query: Can I file a consumer court case for a defective washing machine purchased 18 months ago?

model_output.summary: You can file a complaint in the District Consumer Commission regarding a defective washing machine purchased 18 months ago, provided the cost of the machine was under Rs. 50 Lakhs. You can ask for a replacement, repair, refund, or compensation for the defect.
facts_extracted: Purchased a washing machine 18 months ago

options.title: File a Consumer Complaint Online or Offline
options.description: You can file a formal complaint with the District Consumer Commission where you live or where the seller operates. You can file it in person, by post, or online through the e-Daakhil portal along with your purchase bill and proof of the defect.
pros: Can seek replacement, refund, or compensation for loss or injury
Can be filed online easily via e-Daakhil portal
cons: Requires valid purchase receipts and proof of the defect
Can take time to resolve through legal proceedings

citations.relevance: Explains that the District Commission has the power to handle complaints where the value of goods paid is up to Rs. 50 Lakhs and where you reside.
Outlines how you can file your consumer complaint in person, by post, or online via the e-Daakhil portal.
Details the types of relief you can ask for, such as product replacement, refund of price, or compensation for defects.
